description: This file defines the `OfbizCacheStorage` class, which implements the `CacheStorage` interface. It provides a custom caching mechanism for FreeMarker templates within the Apache OFBiz framework, utilizing the `UtilCache` utility for cache operations localized to a web application context.

classes.name: OfbizCacheStorage
classes.description: A cache implementation for FreeMarker templates, using `UtilCache` for local cache management.

methods.name: OfbizCacheStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a specific identifier, creating a new `UtilCache` instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object corresponding to the provided key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache with the specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cached object associated with the given key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the cache.
